findings.finding: The full pre-multiplication validity row remains binding, but the F oracle makes converted-overflow admission conditional: "If pre-multiplication validity requires excluding overflowing finite seconds". Authority rejection and radarPrecipNow=0 are necessary but do not by themselves decide whether an overflowing epoch may dispatch an Image or become an installed diagnostic record. D79 supplies a useful narrow guard when an invalid derived epoch is stored; F still leaves the executor a different authority-only path without an amendment.
findings.counterexample: Declared legal finite Number.MAX_VALUE seconds multiplies to Infinity. A source path that dispatches Image/retains invalid derived metadata but later reports radarEvidence.available=false can satisfy the unconditional consumer assertions in A01. No native/VM run of this counterexample was performed in this review; this is an oracle/branch ambiguity against the preserved original row.
findings.smallestCorrection: Bind the default B04 oracle: validate raw numeric seconds, convert once, require finite valid frame/index epochs before their relevant Image/admission/install use; overflowing frame seconds must not dispatch Image or install an invalid derived epoch. Preserve evidence that current authority already fails closed; any failure is a diagnostic/admission gap, not an invented live precipitation defect. If primary instead adopts authority-only diagnostic retention, require an explicit owner amendment/disposition naming that narrowed original clause before the row can close. Remove the unresolved "if ... requires" from the final acceptance and metadata; keep any needed authored guard/negative/healthy proof and separate future source/build/delivery authorization.
findings.scopeLimit: No production defect prevalence, P0, provider incident or unauthorized repair is inferred.

findings.finding: The native matched 18ff-versus-new-information comparison is valid for the remaining formatter delta. Both sides already include the state scaffold, so it cannot quantify the surviving original scaffold overhead obligation. Absolute cold/cached reconciliation function cost is useful but is not yet a defined comparable overhead baseline. The specification correctly leaves 2421 unverified if comparability is absent, yet it does not define how the missing comparable scaffold input is acquired or which bounded decision resolves that input.
findings.counterexample: Identical large state-scaffold CPU/heap cost on both 18ff and candidate cancels out of the native formatter delta. Positive no-added-network/cached-identity checks and unchanged formatter overhead would pass while original state-scaffold overhead remains unmeasured. This is a comparison-scope counterexample, not a measured current performance regression.
findings.smallestCorrection: Keep the matched native formatter comparison, and add a separately identified paired scaffold benchmark/control with the same admitted records, target/clock/expiry transitions, worker/renderer environment and instrumentation overhead. Bind exactly what is disabled/tared in an isolated resource-only control, raw CPU/retained-and-allocated-memory/network measures, scope and review oracle; never use this control as correctness or pixel proof. Alternatively add an explicit bounded baseline-acquisition/primary-decision gate with available candidates, comparability checks, output identity and stop disposition. 2421 cannot be closed from formatter-only delta plus unpaired absolute function timing. Retain proposed variance-based budget as labelled design policy and reject unexplained exceedances.
findings.scopeLimit: Do not compare the entire historic fd2972 renderer with CP9/Moon and attribute total difference to weather; no field study, telemetry or new performance framework is requested.

Update comment/metadata/CLI adaptation steps consistently.
